disciplines.name: Animalism
disciplines.summary: Extends the Beast's dominion over animals, familiars, territory, and the feral impulses of living beings.

levels.name: Feral Whispers
levels.summary: Communicate with animals and issue simple commands.
levels.duration: Scene; a command may persist up to one night
levels.effect: Communicate with animals the vampire can address and give simple commands appropriate to the animal.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The animal misunderstands and gives false information or follows a twisted version of the command.
rollResults.failure: The animals flee from the vampire's Beast.
rollResults.success: The vampire communicates with the animal and may give a simple command with simple contingencies.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The animal follows the spirit of the command with unusual initiative.

levels.name: Raise Familiar
levels.summary: Raise a drained animal as a loyal undead familiar.
levels.requirement: Feed 1 Vitae to the animal corpse; included in the cost
levels.effect: The corpse rises with Intelligence 1, takes bashing from attacks like a vampire, does not bleed out or decompose, and can receive silent Feral Whispers at any distance. Each additional Vitae renews its duration as if freshly raised.

levels.name: Summon the Hunt
levels.summary: Call predators and scavengers to blood marked prey.
levels.requirement: Spill 1 Vitae on the target; included in the cost
levels.duration: One night or until the blood-marked target is destroyed
levels.effect: Summon all predators/scavengers, or one chosen kind, within a radius determined by successes. Animals that taste the Vitae can receive one shared Feral Whispers command lasting one night per success.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Called animals lash out at the vampire in fear.
rollResults.success: Matching animals answer the call and may receive one shared command.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Animals pursue the command without stopping to eat or sleep.

levels.name: Feral Infection
levels.summary: Spread the Beast's rage through an area.
levels.requirement: Spill 1 Vitae on the ground; included in the cost
levels.effect: Animals smelling the blood enter feral rage. Humans and supernatural beings resist with Resolve + Composure minus the vampire's successes; recent contact with the vampire's blood gives a further penalty. Failed resistance drives victims into frenzy or atavistic violence under broad direction.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire is provoked to frenzy and suffers a penalty to resist it.
rollResults.failure: Affected animals behave strangely but do not enter rage.
rollResults.success: Affected creatures enter feral rage; the vampire may direct them toward a simple target or goal.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The vampire gains the Sated Condition.

levels.name: Lord of the Land
levels.summary: Claim a blood-marked territory and dominate events within it.
levels.requirement: Walk the boundary while marking it with Vitae; the Vitae cost scales with territory size
levels.duration: At least one week per Blood Potency; persists while the vampire remains in the territory
levels.effect: Animals avoid the territory unless invited or controlled. Intruders resist entering/staying and suffer broad penalties unless exceptionally successful. The vampire senses intruders and their rough locations, gains special command over animals and frenzying creatures, and may use raised familiars as remote sensory/command relays.

disciplines.name: Auspex
disciplines.summary: Heightens perception until the vampire can read danger, secrets, objects, minds, and distant places.

levels.name: Beast's Hackles
levels.summary: Ask the Beast about immediate danger or weakness.
levels.cost: First use per scene is free; later uses that scene cost 1 Vitae
levels.effect: Ask one immediate question about danger or weakness; the Beast answers through sensory imagery.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The Storyteller gives false or warped information.
rollResults.failure: The Beast reveals no immediate weakness.
rollResults.success: Ask one appropriate question.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Ask two appropriate questions.

levels.name: Uncanny Perception
levels.summary: Read secrets and weaknesses in one subject.
levels.cost: First use per scene against a target is free; later uses against the same target that scene cost 1 Vitae
levels.effect: Ask questions about the subject's mood, fears, supernatural nature, hidden control, vulnerabilities, and similar secrets.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The Storyteller gives false or misleading information.
rollResults.success: Ask one question per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The answers also provide additional insight.

levels.name: The Spirit's Touch
levels.summary: Read impressions attached to an object or place.
levels.requirement: A particular object can be examined only once per scene
levels.effect: Ask questions about an object's or place's history, ownership, strongest emotions, and associated events.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The Storyteller gives false or misleading information.
rollResults.failure: The subject yields no useful impression.
rollResults.success: Ask one question per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Gain a bonus when using or interacting with the subject for the rest of the scene.

levels.name: Lay Open the Mind
levels.summary: Read and project thoughts and memories.
levels.dicePool: Intelligence + Socialize + Auspex vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Hear the subject's surface thoughts and project thoughts, images, or memories. Deep memories can be dragged up; each additional deep memory after the initial allowance costs Vitae.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire cannot separate thoughts and gains the Confused Condition.
rollResults.success: Establish the mental link for the scene.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Retrieve deep memories up to Auspex dots before paying additional Vitae.

levels.name: Twilight Projection
levels.summary: Project the senses and consciousness outside the body.
levels.effect: The vampire's consciousness travels astrally within the lunar sphere while the body remains corpse-like and vulnerable. Astral Speed is multiplied by Auspex + Blood Potency. The form passes through physical barriers but cannot physically interact or use Disciplines. Each sunrise away costs one temporary Blood Potency; reaching 0 causes Final Death.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The consciousness is displaced far from the intended location.
rollResults.success: The vampire projects and may travel until returning to the body.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The vampire may later spend Vitae reflexively to snap back to the body or the edge of a blocking mystical boundary.

disciplines.name: Celerity
disciplines.summary: Persistent supernatural speed and reflexive bursts fueled by Vitae.
disciplines.cost: None or 1 Vitae per active effect
disciplines.action: None for persistent effects; Reflexive for active effects
disciplines.duration: Permanent for persistent effects; one turn for active effects
disciplines.effect: Persistent: add Celerity to Defense and Dodge; even firearms that deny Defense suffer a penalty equal to Celerity when the vampire can react. Active: each Vitae buys one distinct effect for the turn — jump to the head of Initiative, interrupt another character with a brief action, or multiply Speed by Celerity + 1. No active option may be used more than once per turn.

disciplines.name: Dominate
disciplines.summary: Imposes commands, false memories, and possession through supernatural authority.

levels.name: Mesmerize
levels.summary: Place a victim in a receptive trance.
levels.dicePool: Intelligence + Expression + Dominate vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Mesmerized; while Mesmerized, short direct commands can be issued as instant actions.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim sees through the attempt and gains Steadfast.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Mesmerized.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: A command may be issued in the same action.

levels.name: Iron Edict
levels.summary: Issue a longer command to a Mesmerized victim.
levels.cost: 1 Vitae; free if the victim is in Vinculum with the vampire
levels.duration: Until the task is completed or sunrise
levels.effect: Give up to three sentences of direct instructions; the victim gains Dominated and follows the command.

levels.name: Entombed Command
levels.summary: Plant subconscious triggers for Dominate effects.
levels.cost: None; linked Dominate effects may cost Vitae
levels.duration: One week per success; one month per success if the victim is in Vinculum
levels.effect: Implant one trigger per success. Each trigger activates a specified Mesmerize, Iron Edict, or Lying Mind effect when encountered.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Mesmerized ends and the attempted trigger grants Steadfast when encountered during the next week.
rollResults.success: Implant triggers equal to successes.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Reduce the Vitae cost of implanted Iron Edict and Lying Mind by one.

levels.name: The Lying Mind
levels.summary: Permanently rewrite or suppress memories.
levels.requirement: Victim has Mesmerized and consumes or is anointed with 1 Vitae included in the cost
levels.effect: Create, erase, or alter memories and inflict Amnesia or False Memories as appropriate. Entombed Command can make the change conditional on a trigger.

levels.name: Possession
levels.summary: Take control of another person's body.
levels.effect: Use the victim's body, Physical Attributes, Skills, and Physical/Combat Merits. The vampire's own body lies in a torpor-like state. Disciplines and Blood Sorcery are unavailable while possessing another body.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Mesmerized ends and the victim regains Willpower.
rollResults.success: Possess the victim for one night per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Regain Willpower when leaving the body.

disciplines.name: Majesty
disciplines.summary: Turns supernatural presence into fascination, trust, jealousy, loyalty, and worship.

levels.name: Awe
levels.summary: Become the unquestioned center of attention.
levels.effect: Ignore Social penalties from appearance or behavior, add Majesty to Presence rolls in normal interaction, and penalize others' attempts to notice anything else.

levels.name: Confidant
levels.summary: Create intimate trust in someone already affected by Awe.
levels.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Majesty vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Charmed.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire gains Swooning for the victim.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Charmed.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Charmed lasts nights rather than hours.

levels.name: Green Eyes
levels.summary: Manipulate the emotions and obsessive loyalty of Charmed or Enthralled victims.
levels.effect: Shift affected victims into intense emotional states and leverage Charmed/Enthralled loyalty for requests. Charmed victims stop before lethal harm or breaking points; Enthralled victims tolerate far more.

levels.name: Loyalty
levels.summary: Turn affection into fanatical devotion.
levels.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Majesty vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Enthralled.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim resolves Charmed.
rollResults.failure: The victim remains Charmed but not Enthralled.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Enthralled.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Enthralled lasts one week per Blood Potency.

levels.name: Idol
levels.summary: Elevate Awe into near-worship across a scene.
levels.effect: Enhance Awe. Affected people must overcome Resolve + Blood Potency minus Majesty to harm or embarrass the vampire; Charmed victims may become Enthralled for the scene.

disciplines.name: Nightmare
disciplines.summary: Weaponizes the supernatural terror inspired by the Beast.

levels.name: Dread Presence
levels.summary: Radiate an unsettling aura and conjure brief frightening illusions.
levels.effect: Add Nightmare to mundane Intimidation, prevent affected victims from spending Willpower offensively, and create small short-lived illusions affecting up to two senses.

levels.name: Face of the Beast
levels.summary: Magnify a victim's fear until they flee.
levels.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Nightmare vs. Composure + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Frightened.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim faces the fear and regains Willpower.
rollResults.failure: Fear troubles the victim but does not drive them away.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Frightened.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The vampire learns precisely what the victim fears.

levels.name: The Grand Delusion
levels.summary: Implant a frightening false belief.
levels.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Nightmare vs. Composure + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Delusional with a belief defined by the vampire, within limits.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire gains Delusional based on the intended false belief.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Delusional for the normal duration; Dread Presence extends it by Blood Potency.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The delusion lasts three nights, or longer with Dread Presence.

levels.name: Waking Nightmare
levels.summary: Create a multi-sensory nightmare hallucination.
levels.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Nightmare vs. highest Composure + Blood Potency in group
levels.effect: Create one terrifying alteration or addition perceived across all senses. With Dread Presence it can affect everyone present.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire hallucinates and must resist frenzy.
rollResults.success: The hallucination lasts a scene.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The hallucination lasts a full night.

levels.name: Mortal Terror
levels.summary: Turn an existing fear into lethal supernatural terror.
levels.effect: Deal lethal damage per success and inflict Broken if the victim survives. Dread Presence can also strip Composure temporarily.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim gains a strong bonus to resist Nightmare for the next week.
rollResults.failure: The victim suffers fear but no mechanical harm.
rollResults.success: Deal one lethal damage per success and inflict Broken if the victim survives.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: If the victim dies, the vampire regains Willpower.

disciplines.name: Obfuscate
disciplines.summary: Erases the vampire, companions, objects, and places from attention and memory.

levels.name: Face in the Crowd
levels.summary: Become unremarkable and easy to overlook.
levels.effect: Observers ignore and poorly remember the vampire unless the vampire draws attention. Actions that would draw notice prompt Wits + Composure penalized by Obfuscate.

levels.name: Touch of Shadow
levels.summary: Hide an object or animal from notice.
levels.requirement: Touch the subject; unwilling targets require a touch attack; normal Size limit is the vampire's Size
levels.effect: Apply Face in the Crowd-like occlusion to an object or animal.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The subject becomes conspicuous.
rollResults.success: The subject fades from active notice.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The subject also fails to stand out in photographs or video recorded while the power was active.

levels.name: Cloak of Night
levels.summary: Vanish completely and extend Obfuscate to people.
levels.effect: Touch of Shadow may affect people. Spending Vitae with Face in the Crowd makes the vampire disappear completely; indirect tracking remains possible.

levels.name: The Familiar Stranger
levels.summary: Appear as a subjective or specific expected identity.
levels.effect: When using Face in the Crowd or Touch of Shadow on a person, project a chosen identity or subjective archetype. Objects can likewise be visually redefined within similar Size.

levels.name: Oubliette
levels.summary: Turn a blood-marked haven into a large-scale Obfuscate domain.
levels.requirement: Mark the area's boundaries, gateways, exits, and landmarks with Vitae and sleep a full day there
levels.effect: Use Touch of Shadow, Cloak of Night, and Familiar Stranger at any distance within the haven and affect multiple subjects with a single activation; associated extra Vitae costs are reduced as described by the power.

disciplines.name: Protean
disciplines.summary: Reshapes the vampire through earth, animal adaptations, full forms, and monstrous transformation.

levels.name: Unmarked Grave
levels.summary: Merge with earth or solid material to rest safely.
levels.cost: 0 in soil/earth; otherwise Vitae equal to material Durability
levels.requirement: Hiding place at least the vampire's Size
levels.effect: Merge with the ground, remain mostly insulated from the outside world, retain limited Kindred senses, absorb blood spilled above, and take bashing as the shelter loses Structure.

levels.name: Predatory Aspect
levels.summary: Manifest three chosen predatory adaptations.
levels.effect: Manifest any or all of three stored adaptations. Stored adaptations can be changed by spending a day in Unmarked Grave and Vitae per replacement.

levels.name: Beast's Skin
levels.summary: Assume stored forms of consumed predatory animals.
levels.effect: Use a stored animal's Physical Attributes, Skills, Size, Speed, Health, senses, locomotion, and natural attacks. Store up to Protean dots in forms.

levels.name: Unnatural Aspect
levels.summary: Add one monstrous adaptation when using Predatory Aspect.
levels.effect: Add one stored monstrous adaptation such as Barbed Hands, Hooked Hands, Horrid Talons, Rubbery Flesh, or Wings. Change the stored choice after a full day/night in Unmarked Grave and two Vitae.

levels.name: Primeval Miasma
levels.summary: Dissolve into a predatory cloud of smoke.
levels.effect: Become a mobile smoke cloud immune to physical harm except fire, sunlight, and damaging banes; move through non-airtight barriers, retain Kindred senses, feed from open wounds, and sleep in this form like Unmarked Grave.

disciplines.name: Resilience
disciplines.summary: Persistent supernatural toughness with active damage mitigation.
disciplines.cost: None or 1 Vitae per active effect
disciplines.action: None for persistent effects; Reflexive for active effects
disciplines.duration: Permanent for persistent effects; one turn for active effects
disciplines.effect: Persistent: add Resilience to Stamina and downgrade one aggravated damage per Resilience dot to lethal from most sources, including fire and acquired banes but not sunlight. Active: each Vitae buys one distinct effect for the turn — reduce non-bane damage by Resilience + 1, or reduce fire/acquired-bane damage by Resilience. Sunlight is never reduced by Resilience.

disciplines.name: Vigor
disciplines.summary: Persistent supernatural strength with active bursts of destructive force.
disciplines.cost: None or 1 Vitae per active effect
disciplines.action: None for persistent effects; Reflexive for active effects
disciplines.duration: Permanent for persistent effects; one turn for active effects
disciplines.effect: Persistent: add Vigor to Strength and multiply jump distance by Vigor + 1. Active: each Vitae buys one distinct effect for the turn — add Vigor as weapon bonus to Athletics/Brawl/Weaponry attacks, or lift and hurl otherwise unwieldy objects using the Discipline's improvised-weapon rules.

disciplines.name: Dead Signal
disciplines.summary: Reads transmissions of the God-Machine and temporarily reconfigures living receivers.

levels.name: Analyze Signal
levels.summary: Identify Radio Sickness or a Stigmata and, with exceptional insight, learn how it arose.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: A burst of static inflicts 2 bashing damage on the vampire.
rollResults.failure: The signal is unreadable and may be mistaken for something else.
rollResults.success: Learn whether the target has Radio Sickness or a Stigmata.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Also learn the sickness's progress and triggering omen, or receive a broad vision of how the Stigmata arose.

levels.name: Minor Repairs
levels.summary: Repair non-persistent Conditions or bashing damage with Vitae.
levels.cost: 1 Vitae per Condition or bashing damage healed

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The target gains Shaken.
rollResults.success: Each Vitae heals one non-persistent Condition or one bashing damage.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: One Vitae heals one Condition, including a persistent one, and two bashing damage.

levels.name: Receive Transmission
levels.summary: Take another character's Radio Sickness for one night to give them time to interpret the omen.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire takes the sickness until the omen is solved, someone else receives it, or she meets Final Death.
rollResults.success: The vampire suffers the target's current Radio Sickness for one night while the target is temporarily cured.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: When the sickness returns to the target, it returns at its first stage.

levels.name: Configure Receiver
levels.summary: Temporarily raise a target's Skills and, on an exceptional success, one Attribute.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: No traits change and the vampire gains Radio Sickness.
rollResults.success: Every 2 Vitae raises one Skill by one dot, to a maximum of 5.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The vampire may raise one Attribute under the same cost as well as Skills.

levels.name: Broadcast
levels.summary: Broadcast a summons to nearby servants of the God-Machine.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Nearby demons are angered and seek the source of the broadcast.
rollResults.success: Nearby Jharana, Holy Engineers, Stigmatics, and other servants hear the call and arrive at least initially friendly.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: An angel arrives with a message and answers questions as well as it can.

disciplines.name: Praestantia
disciplines.summary: Akhud speed expressed as perfect initiative and Dexterity.

levels.name: Praestantia •
levels.summary: Add Praestantia to Initiative and Dexterity pools; Vitae applies it as a weapon bonus or redirects a failed violent action.

levels.name: Praestantia ••
levels.summary: Increase the persistent and active Praestantia bonuses to two dice.

levels.name: Praestantia •••
levels.summary: Increase the persistent and active Praestantia bonuses to three dice.

levels.name: Praestantia ••••
levels.summary: Increase the persistent and active Praestantia bonuses to four dice.

levels.name: Praestantia •••••
levels.summary: Increase the persistent and active Praestantia bonuses to five dice.

disciplines.name: Vitiate
disciplines.summary: Bekaak corruption that weakens bodies by proximity and touch.

levels.name: Vitiate •
levels.summary: Close contact penalizes the subject's next Physical action; Vitae strips Initiative or inflicts a temporary impairment.

levels.name: Vitiate ••
levels.summary: Increase Vitiate's persistent penalty and active reach.

levels.name: Vitiate •••
levels.summary: Increase Vitiate's persistent penalty and active reach.

levels.name: Vitiate ••••
levels.summary: Increase Vitiate's persistent penalty and active reach.

levels.name: Vitiate •••••
levels.summary: Increase Vitiate's persistent penalty and active reach.

disciplines.name: Cachexy
disciplines.summary: The Morbus Discipline of sensing, spreading, and accelerating disease.

levels.name: Diagnose
levels.summary: Sense carriers of disease.

levels.name: Contaminate
levels.summary: Render a space a contagion vector for a disease.

levels.name: Inflame
levels.summary: Exacerbate a disease's symptoms.

levels.name: Plague-Bearer
levels.summary: Quickly infect nearby victims with a disease.

levels.name: Accelerate Disease
levels.summary: Worsen even mild sickness to inflict lethal damage.

disciplines.name: Crochan
disciplines.summary: The Bron Discipline of blood, oaths, and indomitable endurance.

levels.name: Swift Flows the Blood
levels.summary: Spend additional Vitae on healing this turn.

levels.name: Blooding the Hunter
levels.summary: Sample a quarry's blood to gain a tracking bonus for the night.

levels.name: Sealing the Covenant
levels.summary: Swear a shared blood oath and take its focus as an added Touchstone.

levels.name: Blood of My Blood
levels.summary: Spend Vitae to heal a touched subject immediately.

levels.name: Conquering the Challenge of the Axe
levels.translatedName: Conquering the Challenge of the Axe
levels.summary: Suffer no damage while honoring an oath not to move or act aggressively.

disciplines.name: Triadic Evolution
disciplines.summary: Manifestations used by Belial's Brood to refine predatory instinct.

levels.name: Animal Magnetism
levels.summary: Add Triadic Evolution to mundane Expression, Persuasion, and Socialize for an hour.

levels.name: Don't Look It in the Eye
levels.translatedName: Don't Look It in the Eye
levels.summary: Add Triadic Evolution to mundane Animal Ken, Intimidation, and Streetwise for an hour.

levels.name: Camouflage
levels.summary: Become invisible while motionless for an hour.

levels.name: Cover Your Tracks
levels.summary: Leave no scent for several nights.

levels.name: Merely a Flesh Wound
levels.summary: Ignore wound penalties for several scenes.

levels.name: Sprint
levels.summary: Add Triadic Evolution to Speed and noncombat Athletics for an hour.

levels.name: Acidic Blood
levels.summary: Your blood grants no Vitae and inflicts lethal damage until sunrise.

levels.name: Fight or Flight
levels.summary: Become immune to ambush for an hour.

levels.name: Perfect Ambush
levels.summary: Add Triadic Evolution to establish surprise for an hour.

levels.name: Trophy
levels.summary: Preserve a body part from a destroyed vampire for years.

levels.name: Instinctual Conversation
levels.summary: Telepathically communicate with anyone bearing a Bestial Condition.

levels.name: Riding the Man
levels.summary: Add Triadic Evolution to one Intelligence or Wits roll.

levels.name: Survive
levels.summary: Add Triadic Evolution to Defense while taking no offensive action.

levels.name: Enter the Zone
levels.summary: Gain the benefits of frenzy for up to an hour.

levels.name: Hounds to the Hunters
levels.summary: Track a recent scent trail through supernatural concealment.

ritualDisciplines.name: Crúac
ritualDisciplines.statusRequirement: Circle of the Crone Status • to learn new Crúac or rites
ritualDisciplines.summary: Ritual Discipline of the Circle of the Crone. Each purchased dot normally grants one free rite, and known rites cannot exceed the Crúac rating.
ritualDisciplines.cost: Rites cost Vitae equal to rite rating before the casting roll
ritualDisciplines.action: Extended; base interval 30 minutes per roll, 15 minutes when Crúac exceeds the rite rating
ritualDisciplines.effect: The unmodified casting pool determines the maximum number of rolls. Rituals fail if interrupted. Standard blood-sorcery roll results and ritual-specific contested/resisted defenses apply.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The ritual fails completely and the sacrifice is lost. Crúac grants Tempted; Theban Sorcery grants Humbled. The next ritual attempted suffers a –2 dice penalty.
rollResults.failure: No successes are accumulated. The ritualist may abandon the ritual or continue; continuing inflicts the Stumbled Condition.
rollResults.success: Accumulate successes. When the ritual's target number of successes is reached, its effect takes place immediately.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: In addition to accumulating successes, choose one: reduce the target successes by the Ritual Discipline dots; reduce the interval to 15 minutes (or 5 minutes if the Discipline exceeds the ritual rating); or gain Ecstatic (Crúac) / Raptured (Theban Sorcery) if the ritual succeeds.

suggestedModifiers.situation: Power targets or applies to a vampire with existing blood sympathy; Crúac doubles this modifier.
The ritualist is rushed or distracted; multiple distractions are cumulative.
The ritualist prepares an elaborate ritual beyond the minimum sacrifice.
Theban only: successful meditation; bonus equals meditation successes.
Crúac only: extra Vitae sacrificed beyond the requirement; bonus equals excess Vitae.

ritualDisciplines.name: Theban Sorcery
ritualDisciplines.statusRequirement: Lancea et Sanctum Status • to learn new Theban Sorcery or miracles
ritualDisciplines.summary: Ritual Discipline of the Lancea et Sanctum. Each purchased dot normally grants one free miracle, and known miracles cannot exceed the Theban rating.
ritualDisciplines.cost: 1 Willpower plus the miracle's sacrament before the casting roll
ritualDisciplines.action: Extended; base interval 30 minutes per roll, 15 minutes when Theban Sorcery exceeds the miracle rating
ritualDisciplines.effect: The unmodified casting pool determines the maximum number of rolls. Rituals fail if interrupted. The caster's Humanity must be at least the miracle's rating.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The ritual fails completely and the sacrifice is lost. Crúac grants Tempted; Theban Sorcery grants Humbled. The next ritual attempted suffers a –2 dice penalty.
rollResults.failure: No successes are accumulated. The ritualist may abandon the ritual or continue; continuing inflicts the Stumbled Condition.
rollResults.success: Accumulate successes. When the ritual's target number of successes is reached, its effect takes place immediately.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: In addition to accumulating successes, choose one: reduce the target successes by the Ritual Discipline dots; reduce the interval to 15 minutes (or 5 minutes if the Discipline exceeds the ritual rating); or gain Ecstatic (Crúac) / Raptured (Theban Sorcery) if the ritual succeeds.

suggestedModifiers.situation: Power targets or applies to a vampire with existing blood sympathy; Crúac doubles this modifier.
The ritualist is rushed or distracted; multiple distractions are cumulative.
The ritualist prepares an elaborate ritual beyond the minimum sacrifice.
Theban only: successful meditation; bonus equals meditation successes.
Crúac only: extra Vitae sacrificed beyond the requirement; bonus equals excess Vitae.

ritualDisciplines.name: Kimiya
ritualDisciplines.summary: Jaliniyya blood alchemy; each dot grants one free formula and additional formulae cost two Experiences.
ritualDisciplines.cost: 1 Vitae plus blood sacrifice equal to formula rating − 1, minimum 1

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The ritualist gains Jaded.
rollResults.success: The formula takes effect.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The ritualist gains Inspired.

ritualDisciplines.name: Therion
ritualDisciplines.statusRequirement: Tenth Choir membership in good standing
ritualDisciplines.summary: Tenth Choir blood sorcery; each dot grants one free Sacrilege and additional Sacrileges cost two Experiences.
ritualDisciplines.cost: Vitae equal to Sacrilege rating, acquired by feeding from a Grigor
ritualDisciplines.effect: If Humanity is not higher than the Sacrilege rating, committing it causes a breaking point with dice equal to the ritual rating.

ritualDisciplines.name: Gilded Cage
ritualDisciplines.summary: Architect blood sorcery that alters urban flows through prepared Ways and Means. Each dot grants one free Invocation; additional Invocations cost two Experiences.
ritualDisciplines.cost: The Invocation's Ways and Means must be present but are not consumed
ritualDisciplines.effect: Invocations affect defined urban areas. A dramatic failure inflicts Competitive instead of Humbled; an exceptional success on three successes also grants Convergence.

devotions.name: Body of Will
devotions.summary: Ignore wound penalties briefly and turn new injuries into free Vigor activations.
devotions.effect: For the duration, ignore wound penalties; on turns when damage is taken, one Vigor effect may be activated without Vitae.

devotions.name: Chain of Command
devotions.summary: Plant one Dominate effect in a victim for later use against a designated subject.
devotions.dicePool: Intelligence + Persuasion + Dominate vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, the victim carries one specified Dominate effect and later uses it with the vampire's dice pool.

devotions.name: Cloak the Gathering
devotions.summary: Extend Obfuscate to a group within the vampire's aura.
devotions.effect: Expand Touch of Shadow to up to Blood Potency people nearby; extra Vitae can apply Cloak of Night to the whole group.

devotions.name: Conditioning
devotions.summary: Erode a Mesmerized victim's will over repeated sessions.
devotions.requirement: Victim has Mesmerized; same victim only once every two nights
devotions.dicePool: Wits + Subterfuge + Dominate vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Repeated successes build Subservient marks across Willpower until the victim becomes Enslaved.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Mesmerized ends and the victim retains the normal resistance bonus.
rollResults.success: Apply Subservient.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Apply an extra Subservient mark.

devotions.name: Cross-Contamination
devotions.summary: Blend awe and terror into a disorienting emotional aura.
devotions.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + lower of Majesty or Nightmare
devotions.effect: Reduce effective Composure by one, make looking away require a contested roll, and remove 10-again from resistance to Persuasion/Intimidation Social Maneuvering. Cannot coexist with Awe or Dread Presence.

devotions.name: Cult of Personality
devotions.summary: Broadcast Loyalty across a crowd.
devotions.effect: Anyone present whose Composure + Blood Potency is lower than the vampire's successes gains Enthralled.

devotions.name: Enchantment
devotions.summary: Redirect Loyalty to another person, place, or object.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Works as Loyalty, but the source of Enthralled may be a communicated alternate person, place, or object.

devotions.name: Enfeebling Aura
devotions.summary: Trade Majesty dots to suppress a victim's physical Disciplines for the scene.
devotions.dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, sacrifice Majesty dots one-for-one to remove up to successes total dots from the target's Celerity, Resilience, and Vigor.

devotions.name: Foul Grave
devotions.summary: Project predatory aura while resting in an Unmarked Grave.
devotions.effect: Gain limited awareness of nearby mortals and Kindred while interred and activate predatory aura normally from the grave.

devotions.name: Force of Nature
devotions.summary: Assume multiple Protean advantages and redistribute Physical Attributes.
devotions.effect: Gain as many Predatory Aspect, Beast's Skin, and Unnatural Aspect advantages as desired without their Vitae costs; adaptations can change reflexively. An instant action may shift up to Protean dots among Physical Attributes.

devotions.name: Gargoyle's Vigilance
devotions.summary: Gain complete vigilance over a haven while remaining still.
devotions.requirement: Remain stationary for at least ten minutes in a Safe Place
devotions.effect: Project Auspex from any point in the haven, gain a major bonus to detect intruders, gain an Initiative bonus when moving against one, and activate Resilience without Vitae. Willpower allows use while sleeping.

devotions.name: Hint of Fear
devotions.summary: Use Face of the Beast as a rapid reflexive glance.
devotions.cost: 1 Vitae plus Face of the Beast's cost
devotions.dicePool: None; roll Face of the Beast normally
devotions.effect: Face of the Beast becomes reflexive and may be subtle if the vampire does not designate herself as the fear's source.

devotions.name: Juggernaut's Gait
devotions.summary: Become briefly immune to all damage.
devotions.effect: Take no damage from any source, including fire and sunlight, while maintained. The Vitae may be prepared across previous turns subject to normal expenditure limits.

devotions.name: Quicken Sight
devotions.summary: Perceive fast events in slow motion and react accordingly.
devotions.effect: Read and inspect very fast events, apply Defense to ranged attacks, and gain the benefit of aiming immediately.

devotions.name: Reason's Salon
devotions.summary: Suppress predatory aggression within a prepared gathering place.
devotions.effect: Within the prepared location, vampires suffer the user's Resilience as a penalty to predatory aura rolls and gain the same value as a bonus to resist frenzy.

devotions.name: Riot
devotions.summary: Drive a wide area into selfish, destructive bedlam.
devotions.effect: Characters in a large area whose Composure + Blood Potency is below the vampire's successes gain Bestial, Competitive, and Wanton. Use is a Humanity 1 breaking point.

devotions.name: Shared Sight
devotions.summary: Temporarily lend Auspex dots to another person.
devotions.effect: Transfer up to successes Auspex dots. The borrower uses their own Attributes/Skills; the lender loses that many dice from Auspex rolls for the duration.

devotions.name: Shatter the Shroud
devotions.summary: Destroy a concealment effect after winning a Clash of Wills.
devotions.effect: When the vampire wins a Clash of Wills to pierce hiding, the opposing concealment ends immediately.

devotions.name: Stalwart Servant
devotions.summary: Lend Resilience through Vitae to a servant.
devotions.effect: After feeding, the subject gains the vampire's Resilience dots if lower than the vampire's rating, including passive benefits and one Vitae to activate it. Subjects maintained at once are limited by Blood Potency.

devotions.name: Subsume the Lesser Beast
devotions.summary: Project the vampire's mind into a predatory or scavenging animal.
devotions.requirement: Feed 1 Vitae to the animal; included in the cost
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Animal Ken + Animalism – animal Resolve
devotions.effect: Take over the animal's body while the vampire's body lies torpor-like. Use the animal's Physical traits and abilities; normal Disciplines/Blood Sorcery are unavailable.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The animal rejects control and the vampire suffers animalistic tics and Social penalties for the night.
rollResults.success: Control lasts one night per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Auspex remains available while inhabiting the animal.

devotions.name: Summoning (Dominate)
devotions.summary: Compel a previously Mesmerized subject to travel to the vampire.
devotions.requirement: Mesmerized the victim within the last year
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Persuasion + Dominate vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: The subject knows where the vampire is and feels compelled to travel there by the most direct practical means.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim actively avoids the vampire.
rollResults.success: The compulsion lasts through the vampire's current night.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The compulsion continues through the following day and night.

devotions.name: Summoning (Majesty)
devotions.summary: Compel a previous subject of Awe to travel to the vampire.
devotions.requirement: Used Awe on the victim within the last year
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Persuasion + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: The subject knows where the vampire is and feels compelled to travel there by the most direct practical means.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim actively avoids the vampire.
rollResults.success: The compulsion lasts through the vampire's current night.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The compulsion continues through the following day and night.

devotions.name: Sun's Brutal Dreamscape
devotions.summary: Make a sleeping Kindred victim share the vampire's sunlight wounds.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Nightmare vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: While active, a touched sleeping Kindred takes every sunlight wound the vampire takes; awakening from this damage also inflicts Frightened.

devotions.name: Touch of Deprivation
devotions.summary: Temporarily deny a touched victim one sense or one known Auspex ability.
devotions.dicePool: Intelligence + Medicine + Auspex vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, suppress one chosen sense or a known Auspex ability for the scene.

devotions.name: Undying Familiar
devotions.summary: Make a living ghouled animal rise under Raise Familiar when killed.
devotions.effect: Activate together with Raise Familiar while feeding a living animal. While it remains ghouled, death immediately raises it; its undead duration is measured in weeks rather than nights.

devotions.name: Wet Dream
devotions.summary: Seed a sleeping victim with intertwined fear and desire.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, the victim's next sleep inflicts both Spooked and Swooning, with subjects chosen by the vampire; resolving both grants only one Beat.

devotions.name: The Wish
devotions.summary: Temporarily exalt a consenting mortal before binding them in lasting enthrallment.
devotions.requirement: Mortal target freely agrees and feeds from the vampire; usable once per character
devotions.effect: Grant Celerity 2, Vigor 2, Majesty 3 usable with Willpower instead of Vitae, and remove normal need for sleep/food/water. At the end, the mortal gains Persistent Enthralled.

devotions.name: Vermin Flood
devotions.summary: Call a destructive plague of small animals over a prepared area.
devotions.requirement: Spread Vitae over an area no larger than a small house or alley
devotions.effect: Every Size 2-or-less animal swarms the area with persistent Celerity/Vigor benefits. Everything except the vampire takes lethal damage equal to Animalism each turn, ignoring mundane armor; movement in the swarm is halved.

devotions.name: Wraith's Presence
devotions.summary: Project a false image elsewhere while using Cloak of Night.
devotions.effect: Project a mostly still, silent image of the chosen subject at a visible location. Touch dispels it; otherwise supernatural piercing uses Clash of Wills.

devotions.name: Annals of Death
devotions.summary: Answer questions about death in a location and foresee deaths.

devotions.name: Bones of the Mountain
devotions.summary: Become living stone and combine formidable physical Disciplines.

devotions.name: Celebrity
devotions.summary: Turn a fan's praise into a temporary Social Merit.

devotions.name: Consumption
devotions.summary: Possess a victim over any distance using only your voice.

devotions.name: Crush of Years
devotions.summary: Press the weight of centuries upon a target.

devotions.name: Dead Man's Reprieve
devotions.summary: Prepare a bath that cloaks its occupants' presence.

devotions.name: Kin Maker
devotions.summary: Pijavica magic that infects another vampire with a gestating childe.

devotions.name: Legion
devotions.summary: Use the senses of all nearby animals of a chosen type.

devotions.name: Malignant Smog
devotions.summary: Turn Primeval Miasma into toxic gas that inflicts Tilts.

devotions.name: Pass Into Yesteryear
devotions.summary: Make others forget those bound to you by Vinculum.

devotions.name: Preternatural Instinct
devotions.summary: Sense danger before it happens and read traces of hostile intent.

devotions.name: Spontaneous Ignition
devotions.summary: Set a touched target on fire.

devotions.name: Unbridled Force
devotions.summary: Perform feats of raw strength at a distance.

devotions.name: Aerial Cocoon
devotions.requirement: Hiding spot has the vampire's Size
devotions.summary: Use Unmarked Grave between concrete or metal walls as a protective cocoon.

devotions.name: Bend Space
devotions.summary: Teleport to a visible or familiar place.

devotions.name: Best Served Cold
devotions.summary: Gain +3 to attacks against the person who harmed you.

devotions.name: Between the Walls
devotions.summary: Fit through Size 2 spaces and add Obfuscate to ambush rolls.

devotions.name: Blood Scenting
devotions.summary: Identify a target's Clan, Blood Potency, and Disciplines.

devotions.name: Distant Control
devotions.summary: Issue commands and make Social rolls through a known target's mind.

devotions.name: Flush Out
devotions.summary: Inflict Frightened and drive hidden subjects into the open.

devotions.name: Memetic Menace
devotions.summary: Alter recordings of yourself to inflict Swooned or Frightened.

devotions.name: Vile Blood
devotions.summary: Make your blood poisonous to feeders and combatants.

devotions.name: Wrack the Mind
devotions.summary: Inflict the Agonized Condition.

devotions.name: Flesh Form
devotions.summary: Consume a human body to imitate its appearance and voice.

devotions.name: Ghost Skin
devotions.summary: Perceive and interact with ghosts during Twilight Projection.

devotions.name: Not So Special
devotions.summary: Suppress another vampire's Clan-specific Disciplines.

devotions.name: Null Space
devotions.summary: Use Vitiate without touch inside Lord of the Land or Oubliette.

devotions.name: Pierce the Veil
devotions.summary: Use Auspex to perceive ghosts and Willpower to affect them with Disciplines.

devotions.name: Séance
devotions.summary: Force a ghost to Materialize at its Anchor.

devotions.name: Water Hibernation
devotions.summary: Use Unmarked Grave while fully submerged in water.

devotions.name: Sea Witch's Gift
devotions.summary: Regain legs for an hour while ignoring the Nereid Bane.

devotions.name: Siren's Sweet Visage
devotions.summary: Conceal abnormalities and weaken resistance to persuasion or intimidation.

devotions.name: Infectious Bite
devotions.summary: Infect a mortal with the Nosoi blood sickness.

devotions.name: Plague Doctor's Mask
devotions.summary: Use Touch of Shadow to mask blood-sickness symptoms.

devotions.name: Tiny Guardian
devotions.summary: Bud off intelligent and loyal insect servants.

devotions.name: City Attunement
devotions.summary: Touch the city to see through its eyes and enable other Scion Devotions.

devotions.name: Incriminating Evidence
devotions.summary: Search your city for evidence of a touched subject's wrongdoing.

devotions.name: Our Mother's Mind
devotions.summary: Seek and impede a quarry through your city.

devotions.name: The Give-and-Take
devotions.summary: Gift a vessel Physical Discipline dots while stealing Vice recovery.

devotions.name: The Look
devotions.summary: Turn exceptional emotional influence into psychic feeding.

devotions.name: The One That Got Away
devotions.summary: Become a sleeping victim's temporary ideal and Vice.

devotions.name: The Pledge
devotions.summary: Pledge to a vessel, granting Social Merits and recovering Willpower through passion.

devotions.name: Shapeshifting
devotions.summary: Copy physical features from a vessel for a night.

devotions.name: Nightmare Journey
devotions.summary: Project into the Primordial Dream and feed from dream forms.

devotions.name: Udjat
devotions.summary: See perfectly in total darkness and ignore blindness from injury or supernatural powers.
devotions.effect: Spending Vitae reveals spirits, Strix, angels, and other Twilight beings and prevents Strix possession for the scene. The first clear manifestation of Obtenebration forces witnesses to roll Resolve + Composure or gain Shaken.
devotions.source: Onyx Path Blog: The Shadow and the Asp

devotions.name: Ba
devotions.summary: Wear a shadow and become a Twilight being.
devotions.effect: Become immaterial while touching a shadow at least your Size. Move at half Speed along solid objects; only fire, sunlight, Pseshkf, ephemeral attacks, and effects that harm ephemera can affect you, but harmful effects inflict two extra lethal damage.
devotions.source: Onyx Path Blog: The Shadow and the Asp

devotions.name: Iteru
devotions.summary: Slip between contiguous shadows and empower a Dodge.
devotions.effect: Emerge anywhere along the same patch of shadow; once per scene a Dodge using Iteru gains rote quality.
devotions.source: Onyx Path Blog: The Shadow and the Asp

devotions.name: Pseshkf
devotions.summary: Coat an object in frozen darkness and wield it through Tyet.
devotions.effect: Add Blood Potency to Durability and Vitae spent to Structure. Coated weapons gain +1 weapon rating against physical targets and Blood Potency weapon rating against noncorporeal targets.
devotions.source: Onyx Path Blog: The Shadow and the Asp

devotions.name: Tyet
devotions.summary: Expel and shape a cloud of supernatural darkness.
devotions.effect: The cloud extends Blood Potency yards per Vitae spent; the Khaibit may shape all connected shadows to distract or deceive.
devotions.source: Onyx Path Blog: The Shadow and the Asp

devotions.name: Hounds of Hell
devotions.summary: Hone the Predatory Aura through the Kerberos Beast.
devotions.effect: When pursuing the Beast's aspect after using Predatory Aura, replace the usual +2 bonus with Blood Potency and add the relevant Three Heads of Kerberos rating to lashing-out pools.
devotions.source: Onyx Path Blog: The Jaws of the Beast

devotions.name: .22 Solid
devotions.summary: Increase Resilience's damage downgrading.

devotions.name: Aegis of Defiance
devotions.summary: Defy mind-altering effects by acting contrary to them.

devotions.name: Aura of Cursive Seduction
devotions.summary: Inflict enthralling Conditions when someone lashes out at you.

devotions.name: BFFs
devotions.summary: Create the convincing facade of a long friendship.

devotions.name: Call Me Maybe
devotions.summary: Create a temporary Herd.

devotions.name: Hekireki
devotions.summary: Bank Vitae across turns before releasing an empowered attack.

devotions.name: Holdout
devotions.summary: Meld objects into your body.

devotions.name: If You Can't Duck It
devotions.prerequisites: Four dots divided among Celerity, Resilience, and Vigor
devotions.summary: Bless an object with physical Discipline power.

devotions.name: Manic Depression
devotions.summary: Force a victim through rapidly shifting emotional extremes.

devotions.name: Natural Born Killer
devotions.summary: Read opponents intuitively and answer with gunfire.

devotions.name: Preserved Blood
devotions.summary: Store your Vitae for later use.

devotions.name: Psycho Mantle
devotions.summary: Retaliate with a terrifying Predatory Aura.

devotions.name: Punching and Fucking
devotions.summary: Exert Majesty through an unarmed attack.

devotions.name: Sudden Strength
devotions.summary: Add Celerity to Strength while Celerity is active.

devotions.name: Rapidity
devotions.summary: Modify another Devotion so it can activate reflexively.

devotions.name: Rock Is Dead
devotions.summary: Strengthen Awe while dulling rival presences.

devotions.name: Slow and Steady
devotions.summary: Slow a power to convert its Attribute dice into successes.

devotions.name: Straight Up Fucking Murderer
devotions.summary: Use a maneuver without sacrificing Defense.

devotions.name: Talking Circles
devotions.summary: Accelerate a conversation and cut off an opponent.

devotions.name: The Gun Show
devotions.summary: Empower Majesty after a feat of strength.

devotions.name: Tune In, Tune Out
devotions.summary: Suppress all but one sense to hyperextend the remaining one.

devotions.name: Under My Skin
devotions.summary: Assume the appearance of someone under your Majesty.

devotions.name: Under My Skin (Greater)
devotions.summary: Exchange appearances with a subject under your Majesty.

devotions.name: Violent Coercion
devotions.summary: Coerce a subject into a task with the threat of violence.

devotions.name: Colossus
devotions.summary: Massively increase the power of your strikes.

devotions.name: In Vitae Veritas
devotions.summary: Send Discipline effects through Kindred lineages.

devotions.name: Kissing Cousins
devotions.summary: Make two vampires count as blood relatives.

devotions.name: Knight Commander
devotions.summary: Inspire the Charmed to martial greatness.

devotions.name: Strength of Empire
devotions.summary: Temporarily steal a physical Discipline from a Vinculum thrall.

devotions.name: Purification
devotions.summary: Bind a living mortal's Purity into a repeating 24-hour stasis and harvest Electrum from lethal harm dealt to that Purity.
devotions.cost: 1 Vitae and 1 Willpower to establish; 1 Vitae each week to maintain
devotions.effect: The mortal cannot be a ghoul or blood bound. A Star-Crossed may sustain Purities up to Blood Potency, and vampire blood immediately ends the effect. Electrum heals, fuels the bloodline's Merits, or restores the vampire's appearance to the night of the Embrace.

devotions.name: Ripples in Still Water
devotions.summary: Recognize supernatural emotional manipulation and, with enough successes, identify its source.
devotions.effect: Free to qualifying Apostates; otherwise purchased as a normal Devotion.

devotions.name: Silence of Depths
devotions.summary: Add Majesty or Nightmare to resistance against emotional supernatural powers and to attempts to break Awe or Dread Presence.

devotions.name: Drowned in the Abyss
devotions.summary: When successfully resisting a supernatural power, reflect it back upon its user.

devotions.name: Doctor's Orders
devotions.summary: After Lay Open the Mind succeeds, use Dominate within the subject's mind without eye contact, speech, or a shared language.
devotions.effect: The chosen Dominate effect still requires its normal roll and costs.

devotions.name: Battering Ram
devotions.summary: Crash through barriers at full speed by reducing their Durability by Resilience.
devotions.effect: When running at full Speed into an object, reduce its Durability by the vampire's Resilience dots.

devotions.name: Body of Steel
devotions.summary: Turn absorbed attacks back against weapons and unarmed attackers.
devotions.effect: After Resilience absorbs an attack, inflict the absorbed Health levels on the melee weapon; a destroyed weapon harms its wielder, while unarmed attackers take the damage directly.

devotions.name: Brood Mother
devotions.summary: Birth a temporary flesh-minion from the vampire's own body.
devotions.effect: Create a Size 2 minion with a Protean + Blood Potency Physical pool, Stamina-based Health, half Defense, optional Vitae, physical Discipline effects, and the vampire's current Predatory Aspect adaptations.

devotions.name: Consume
devotions.summary: Absorb a drained mortal into the vampire's body and borrow the victim's knowledge.
devotions.effect: After draining a mortal to death, gain the victim's stored Willpower and use any higher Mental or Social Skills for the duration.

devotions.name: Earthen Insight
devotions.summary: Learn the rhythms of an area while resting beneath it.
devotions.requirement: Rest for one hour in Unmarked Grave within the area
devotions.effect: Gain 9-again on Drive, Stealth, Streetwise, Survival, and Perception rolls within Blood Potency × 3 kilometers.

devotions.name: Elastic Visage
devotions.summary: Freely reshape cosmetic features and redefine the vampire's default form.
devotions.effect: Alter appearance, voice, build, and cosmetic anatomy; Willpower may grant or remove Striking Looks or redefine the default form in Unmarked Grave.

devotions.name: Endow the Familiar
devotions.summary: Grant a raised animal familiar limited Protean transformations.
devotions.cost: 1 additional Vitae with Raise the Familiar
devotions.effect: The familiar gains two fixed dots of Protean and may change Predatory Aspect adaptations as a vampire can.

devotions.name: Flesh Crafting
devotions.summary: Command a Mesmerized subject's flesh into a new appearance.
devotions.duration: Indefinite on humans; one night on vampires
devotions.effect: Apply Elastic Visage alterations to another character; human changes persist until treated again, while vampires revert in daysleep unless preserved with Willpower.

devotions.name: Flesh Sculpting
devotions.summary: Sculpt a subject's Physical Attributes, Size, and bodily Conditions.
devotions.effect: Move Physical Attribute dots, alter Size from 3 to 7, or inflict bodily Conditions, limited by Protean dots and normal trait limits.

devotions.name: Forced March
devotions.summary: Maintain Celerity's maximum running speed for hours.
devotions.effect: Move continuously at the maximum Speed allowed by Celerity; stopping ends the effect.

devotions.name: Frog Prince
devotions.summary: Transform another character into an animal for the night.
devotions.dicePool: Presence + Animal Ken + Protean vs. Stamina + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: The subject assumes an animal form known to the vampire, including Swarm Form when available.

devotions.name: Gorge
devotions.summary: Swell the body with a temporary reserve of Vitae.
devotions.effect: Store extra Vitae up to Resilience dots until the normal Vitae pool falls below its limit.

devotions.name: Graft
devotions.summary: Attach stolen limbs, organs, or bones and use them as part of the vampire's body.
devotions.effect: Each limb adds Strength and Dexterity; organs or bones add Stamina, up to Blood Potency + 1 attached parts.

devotions.name: Inner Rage
devotions.summary: Escape supernatural coercion by surrendering to an uncontrollable frenzy.
devotions.effect: After failing to resist Dominate, Majesty, Nightmare, or a related Devotion, ignore it and enter an uninfluenceable dramatic-failure frenzy.

devotions.name: It Will Not Die
devotions.summary: Ignore wounds and briefly remain active when torpor should take hold.
devotions.effect: Spend Willpower dots to ignore equal Health levels; once per scene spend a point to delay torpor for Resilience turns. Sunlight and personal banes bypass it.

devotions.name: Regeneration
devotions.summary: Repair aggravated wounds without resting at the cost of severe lethargy.
devotions.effect: Heal aggravated damage immediately and gain Lethargic for scenes equal to the damage healed.

devotions.name: Sheep's Clothing
devotions.summary: Memorize and assume the physical form of a mortal drained to death.
devotions.effect: Use Beast's Skin to copy the victim's Physical traits and appearance; the memorized human form counts against Beast's Skin's form limit.

devotions.name: Walk It Off
devotions.summary: Ignore a personal injury Tilt for a few turns.
devotions.effect: Ignore a Personal Tilt while the affected body part remains attached.

devotions.name: Brain Dead
devotions.summary: Convince a Delusional victim to make reckless, shortsighted mistakes.
devotions.effect: Penalize Mental actions to evade, trick, or outwit the vampire by activation successes.

devotions.name: Friend to Foe
devotions.summary: Redirect suspicion and hostility from the vampire onto a chosen bystander.
devotions.effect: After Touch of Shadow, nearby people transfer their natural suspicion, fear, and hostility toward the vampire onto the victim until the vampire attacks someone else.

devotions.name: Gaslight
devotions.summary: Alter one visible detail of a room and make everyone but one victim accept it as normal.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Obfuscate vs. highest Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Spend Willpower to create the change; witnesses rationalize it and scorn the designated victim for objecting.

devotions.name: Gaze of the Abyss
devotions.summary: Show a Frightened victim incomprehensible horrors that drain Willpower.
devotions.effect: Inflict one point of Willpower loss per success; exceptional success also inflicts Fugue for the night.

devotions.name: Hell Beast
devotions.summary: Warp a raised animal familiar into a larger and more frightening undead beast.
devotions.cost: 1 additional Vitae with Raise the Familiar
devotions.effect: Increase Size and Physical Attributes, add Nightmare to Intimidation, and grant a permanent crude Dread Presence.

devotions.name: Iron Façade
devotions.summary: Conceal all wounds and make the first use of Resilience demoralize attackers.
devotions.effect: Wounds remain visually hidden; witnesses who fail Resolve + Composure – Blood Potency lose 10-again on their attack.

devotions.name: Jump Scare
devotions.summary: Appear from concealment at a victim's most vulnerable instant.
devotions.effect: Against a victim who knows the vampire is nearby but cannot see her, ignore Defense and gain 8-again on the first strike, once per victim per scene.

devotions.name: Living Nightmare
devotions.summary: Project an autonomous, intangible horror that channels the vampire's non-physical powers.
devotions.effect: Create one independent illusion that passes through barriers, cloaks itself, follows simple commands, and can channel non-physical Disciplines and Devotions.

devotions.name: The Loathsome Foe
devotions.summary: Make one victim perceive the vampire as a person they deeply fear.
devotions.dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Obfuscate vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Halve the victim's relevant Attribute in fear contests and add Nightmare to Defense against that victim.

devotions.name: Mania
devotions.summary: Overclock a victim's mind and inflict the Frantic Condition.
devotions.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Nightmare vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Inflict Frantic; on exceptional success it lasts Blood Potency nights.

devotions.name: Mind Killer
devotions.summary: Seize a victim's reasoning center with sustained intimidation.
devotions.dicePool: Intelligence + Intimidation + Nightmare vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: After a minute of conversation, penalize all Wits actions by Nightmare; severe penalties can cause Insensate.

devotions.name: No One Can Hear You Scream
devotions.translatedName: No One Can Hear You Scream
devotions.summary: Wrap a touched victim in a field that reduces every sound to a whisper.
devotions.effect: Suppress the victim's voice, gunshots, and other sounds; exceptional success lasts a scene.

devotions.name: Pied Piper
devotions.summary: Turn music into a lure that rewards listeners for following it and leaves them Spooked.
devotions.effect: Anyone following the music to its source refreshes Willpower and gains Spooked; the vampire must keep playing.

devotions.name: Rampage
devotions.summary: Become a shadowy monster capable of killing many ordinary mortals at once.
devotions.dicePool: Strength + Brawl + Nightmare – number of mortals
devotions.effect: Kill mortals equal to successes; supernatural-tolerance characters and victims armed with fire are exempt. Use is a Humanity 1 breaking point.

devotions.name: Rising Tension
devotions.summary: Turn a watched victim's heartbeat into distracting dread.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Intimidation + Nightmare vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Inflict Shaken, remove 10-again from Physical actions against the vampire, and penalize Perception by Nightmare.

devotions.name: Sign of Terror
devotions.summary: Store a Nightmare power in a Vitae-marked object as a supernatural trap.
devotions.cost: 1 Vitae plus one per extra charge
devotions.effect: The attached Nightmare power activates against viewers under its normal rules, with charges limited by Size to a maximum of five.

devotions.name: Terrible Will
devotions.summary: Harden the vampire against passive and active supernatural fear.
devotions.effect: Ignore Dread Presence and penalize Nightmare rolls against the vampire by Resilience.

devotions.name: This Awful Grip
devotions.summary: Bring monstrous strength to bear against objects and armor.
devotions.effect: Ignore Durability or general armor equal to Vigor on Brawl or Weaponry attacks; witnesses may gain Shaken.

devotions.name: Wicked Grasp
devotions.summary: Distend the vampire's limbs into a terrifying, constricting grapple.
devotions.effect: Set a not-yet-acted victim's Initiative to 1 and penalize later grapple-control rolls by Nightmare.

devotions.name: Wretched Bite
devotions.summary: Infect a bitten victim with supernatural despair.
devotions.effect: A damaging feeding bite inflicts the Persistent Despondent Condition.

devotions.name: Familiar's Eyes
devotions.summary: Experience the world through the senses of a familiar or animal ghoul.

cruacRites.name: Pangs of Proserpina
cruacRites.summary: Provoke supernatural hunger in a distant victim.
cruacRites.effect: A victim within one mile counts as starving for the next frenzy-resistance roll, regardless of recent feeding.

cruacRites.name: Rigor Mortis
cruacRites.summary: Suppress the reanimating force of a vampire's Vitae.
cruacRites.effect: A vampire victim within one mile suffers –3 dice on the next physical action.

cruacRites.name: Cheval
cruacRites.summary: See and hear through a touched subject.
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist sees and hears what the subject does regardless of distance.

cruacRites.name: The Hydra's Vitae
cruacRites.summary: Curse the ritualist's own blood into poison.
cruacRites.effect: Vampires/Strix drinking the ritualist's blood take lethal per Vitae and gain no nourishment; mortals/ghouls take heavier lethal damage.

cruacRites.name: Deflection of Wooden Doom
cruacRites.summary: Ward the ritualist against staking.
cruacRites.effect: All attempts to stake the ritualist fail.

cruacRites.name: Touch of the Morrigan
cruacRites.summary: Charge the ritualist's touch with lethal force.
cruacRites.duration: Until first use or next sunrise
cruacRites.effect: The first successful touch attack inflicts lethal damage equal to ritual Potency and ends the rite.

cruacRites.name: Blood Price
cruacRites.summary: Redirect blood consumed by a subject to the ritualist.
cruacRites.effect: Whenever the subject drinks blood, up to ritual Potency Vitae go to the ritualist first; excess remains with the subject.

cruacRites.name: Willful Vitae
cruacRites.summary: Prevent new Vinculum and blood addiction for the night.
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist is immune to new Vinculum and blood addiction; existing bonds/addiction remain.

cruacRites.name: Blood Blight
cruacRites.summary: Mystically destroy blood or Vitae in a victim.
cruacRites.effect: Mortals take ritual Potency lethal damage; Kindred, Strix, and ghouls lose ritual Potency Vitae, usually provoking hunger frenzy checks in Kindred.

cruacRites.name: Feeding the Crone
cruacRites.summary: Transform feeding into a savage supernatural bite.
cruacRites.duration: Until next sunrise or cancelled with 1 Vitae
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist gains no Vitae from feeding but the bite deals +2 aggravated damage.

cruacRites.name: Mantle of Amorous Fire
cruacRites.summary: Dance to exhaustion and add Crúac as a Presence bonus for the night.
cruacRites.requirement: Dance and activate Blush of Life as part of casting
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist becomes exhausted, regains Willpower as specified by the rite, and adds Crúac to Presence for the night.

cruacRites.name: Pool of Forbidden Truths
cruacRites.summary: Gain Primeval Truths and interpret a prophetic vision.
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist gains the Primeval Truths Condition and may ask for one truthful sentence from the vision per success on the interpretation roll.

cruacRites.name: Mantle of the Beast’s Breath
cruacRites.summary: Dance to exhaustion, gain Raptured, and add Crúac when riding the wave.
cruacRites.requirement: Dance and activate Blush of Life as part of casting
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist gains the Raptured Condition and adds Crúac to attempts to ride the wave for the night.

cruacRites.name: Shed the Virulent Bowels
cruacRites.summary: Hang a lethal curse over a living victim for up to a lunar month.
cruacRites.requirement: A lock of hair or other sympathetic link
cruacRites.effect: When triggered, the curse fills the living victim's Health track with lethal damage at one point per turn.

cruacRites.name: Curse of Aphrodite’s Favor
cruacRites.summary: Create a three-dose potion that forces a full Vinculum to a chosen subject.
cruacRites.requirement: Feed the victim one drop on each of three consecutive nights
cruacRites.effect: After the third dose, the victim suffers a full Vinculum to the chosen subject rather than to the ritualist.

cruacRites.name: Curse of the Beloved Toy
cruacRites.summary: Bind a slain victim's soul into a cherished keepsake that curses later owners.
cruacRites.requirement: A beloved possession and the death of its owner
cruacRites.duration: Until its invested Vitae is exhausted or the spirit is exorcised
cruacRites.effect: Each invested Vitae can turn one action by the item's owner into a dramatic failure; destroying the item only drives the spirit to another host.

cruacRites.name: Donning the Beast’s Flesh
cruacRites.summary: Wear a flayed animal skin to assume an approximation of that beast.
cruacRites.requirement: A garment made from a flayed animal
cruacRites.effect: The wearer approximates the animal's form and retains only Auspex among Disciplines while transformed.

cruacRites.name: Mantle of the Glorious Dervish
cruacRites.summary: Dance to exhaustion and become an untiring supernatural combatant for the night.
cruacRites.requirement: Dance and activate Blush of Life as part of casting
cruacRites.effect: Gain armor 1 against all attacks, deal +1 damage with attacks, and become immune to ambush and surprise.

cruacRites.name: Bounty of the Storm
cruacRites.summary: Prepare a storm that strikes a future crowd, maims the target, and leaves immense wealth.
cruacRites.requirement: A personal or precious object connected to the target
cruacRites.duration: Triggers between one week and one lunar month after casting
cruacRites.effect: The target suffers Crúac bashing damage, roughly one third of the surrounding crowd dies, and the aftermath provides Resources-equivalent wealth; casting risks detachment at Humanity 2.

cruacRites.name: Gorgon’s Gaze
cruacRites.summary: Prepare the ritualist's eyes to petrify the first person who sees them.
cruacRites.effect: Each success petrifies roughly one fifth of the victim and inflicts one aggravated damage; five successes petrify the whole body, killing mortals or placing Kindred in torpor.

cruacRites.name: Mantle of the Predator Goddess
cruacRites.summary: Dance to exhaustion and become a divine predator for the night.
cruacRites.requirement: Dance and activate Blush of Life as part of casting
cruacRites.effect: Add Crúac to feeding rolls and as temporary Herd dots; anyone fed from gains the Raptured Condition.

cruacRites.name: Birthing the God
cruacRites.summary: Assemble body parts and Vitae to violently birth an undead, flesh-eating god.
cruacRites.requirement: A coven, harvested body parts, and invested Vitae
cruacRites.effect: Invested Vitae purchases Attributes and Disciplines, sets Size at one per five Vitae and Blood Potency at one per three Vitae, while celebrants contribute Skills and suffer the creature's violent birth.

cruacRites.name: Denying Hades
cruacRites.summary: Trap a recently deceased spirit in its corpse between life and death.
cruacRites.requirement: A corpse dead no longer than the ritualist's Blood Potency in days
cruacRites.effect: The corpse returns conscious but decaying and sleepless; the ritualist suffers an unhealable aggravated wound until the corpse rests again.

cruacRites.name: Mantle of the Crone
cruacRites.summary: Assume the Crone's terrible mantle, revealing truths and transforming matter through touch.
cruacRites.effect: Witnesses gain Primeval Truths, the ritualist's touch deals aggravated damage, and Willpower can animate an object as a lizard-like animal for the night.

cruacRites.name: Manananggal's Working
cruacRites.summary: Dismember yourself and animate the separated parts independently until sunrise.

cruacRites.name: Gwydion's Curse
cruacRites.summary: Animate nearby plants to attack intruders until sunrise.

cruacRites.name: Scapegoat
cruacRites.summary: Transfer breaking points and acquired banes to a mortal vessel for the night.

cruacRites.name: Sanguine Augur
cruacRites.summary: Dream cryptic revelations about the last vessel you fed from.

cruacRites.name: Wisdom of the Blood
cruacRites.summary: Read prophecies about a subject in a torpid vampire's dreams.

cruacRites.name: Clotho's Skein
cruacRites.summary: Dreamwalk through daysleep connections to implant a suggestion.

cruacRites.name: The Red Blossoms
cruacRites.summary: Grow plants into an archway that opens into the Hedge.
cruacRites.source: Changeling: The Lost Second Edition — The Hedge

cruacRites.name: Ma'at and Kauket
cruacRites.summary: Invert the spiritual resonance of an area and alter its Resonant Condition.

cruacRites.name: Ahmet's Pursuit
cruacRites.summary: Curse a nearby subject through a material focus, inflicting Lost and revealing the target's location for the rest of the night.

cruacRites.name: Hand of Seth
cruacRites.summary: Exorcise a possessing ephemeral entity from its host.

cruacRites.name: Doom of Osiris
cruacRites.summary: Consecrate a bladed weapon so its attacks inflict aggravated damage upon ephemeral beings.

cruacRites.name: Feast of Ka
cruacRites.summary: Force a Hollow Mekhet's Ka to materialize and feed it Essence.

cruacRites.name: Thrashing of Apep's Coils
cruacRites.summary: Call violent rain over the ritual area and optionally add heavy winds; prepared allies are protected.

cruacRites.name: Prey's Blood
cruacRites.summary: Track a recent vessel by cardinal direction and empower attempts to follow the trail.
cruacRites.effect: Sense the subject's direction and add Crúac to Investigation, Survival, and Kindred Senses rolls to track them.

cruacRites.name: Tickblood
cruacRites.summary: Double a victim's Vitae capacity and make their blood unnaturally nourishing.
cruacRites.effect: Feeding from the subject yields two Vitae per lethal damage and the swollen body gains two general armor except against bites.

cruacRites.name: Balancing the Four Humors
cruacRites.summary: Brew doses that protect against extreme environments and Environmental Tilts.
cruacRites.effect: Consumers add the ritualist's Crúac to rolls penalized by extreme environments or Environmental Tilts, except fire and sunlight.

cruacRites.name: Sacrifice of Odin
cruacRites.summary: Maim the ritualist to empower Willpower and resistance for as long as the wound remains.
cruacRites.effect: An aggravated self-mutilation grants +5 from Willpower on actions, +3 to Resistance Attributes, and a chance to recover Willpower spent on mundane actions.

cruacRites.name: Curse of Ahasverus
cruacRites.summary: Make a victim appear as a hostile outsider to every vampire they meet.
cruacRites.effect: Kindred must spend Willpower not to lash out at the victim, and frenzy resistance near them is penalized by Potency.

thebanMiracles.name: Blood Scourge
thebanMiracles.summary: Create a temporary whip of Vitae.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: At least 1 Vitae of the ritualist's own blood
thebanMiracles.duration: Until sunrise; created whip lasts until scene end
thebanMiracles.effect: Create a 2L Vitae whip at any point before sunrise.

thebanMiracles.name: Vitae Reliquary
thebanMiracles.summary: Store Vitae in a sacramental object.
thebanMiracles.effect: Transfer up to ritual Potency Vitae into the object. Vampires, Strix, or ghouls can later retrieve it; normal bond/addiction risks apply.

thebanMiracles.name: Blandishment of Sin
thebanMiracles.summary: Upgrade the next bashing damage a distant victim suffers.
thebanMiracles.effect: The next bashing damage from one attack becomes lethal. A separate four-dot version with 8 target successes upgrades lethal to aggravated.

thebanMiracles.name: Curse of Babel
thebanMiracles.summary: Prevent a victim from speaking or writing.
thebanMiracles.effect: A victim within one mile cannot speak or write.

thebanMiracles.name: Liar's Plague
thebanMiracles.summary: Punish a present victim for telling falsehoods.
thebanMiracles.effect: If the victim lies during the next scene, beetles swarm from the victim's mouth.

thebanMiracles.name: Malediction of Despair
thebanMiracles.summary: Curse one specified future action.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A lock of the victim's hair
thebanMiracles.duration: Until triggered or one lunar month
thebanMiracles.effect: The next time the victim performs the specified action, suffer –5 dice once.

thebanMiracles.name: Gift of Lazarus
thebanMiracles.summary: Animate a human corpse as a servant.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A communion wafer under the corpse's tongue
thebanMiracles.effect: Raise a corpse retaining its former Skills but no Willpower; age of corpse degrades Attributes. It is destroyed by enough aggravated damage or when the miracle expires.

thebanMiracles.name: Stigmata
thebanMiracles.summary: Inflict miraculous bleeding wounds.
thebanMiracles.effect: Mortals take one lethal per turn; vampires and ghouls lose one Vitae per turn, then take lethal if a vampire reaches zero Vitae.

thebanMiracles.name: Transubstantiation
thebanMiracles.summary: Transform one present substance, creature, or person into another form.
thebanMiracles.effect: Transform a subject no larger than the ritualist without creating intelligence or directly healing/harming it; existing injuries remain and the change reverses at sunrise.

thebanMiracles.name: Apple of Eden
thebanMiracles.summary: Infuse a fruit that expands a human's intellect and supernatural perception.
thebanMiracles.effect: A human eater suffers a breaking point, distributes dots equal to Theban Sorcery between Intelligence and Wits, and safely perceives supernatural beings for days; the benefit can be made permanent with Experience.

thebanMiracles.name: Marian Apparition
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless cloth that reveals a shaming holy apparition when torn.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: White cloth stained with menstrual blood
thebanMiracles.effect: All witnesses see the apparition. Kindred who lose the contest add the caster's Theban Sorcery to Humanity for detachment, while Crúac cast beneath it gains the same bonus.

thebanMiracles.name: Revelatory Shroud
thebanMiracles.summary: Reveal the face of the last person to touch an object or pass through an area.
thebanMiracles.effect: Cover the subject with the blessed shroud to display the face of the last person who touched the object or crossed the covered place.

thebanMiracles.name: Apparition of the Host
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless a switch that terrorizes a victim with angelic phantasms.
thebanMiracles.duration: The switch remains blessed for one month
thebanMiracles.effect: When snapped, the target gains Frightened, or Spooked if mortal; spending Willpower can make the apparition visible only to the victim.

thebanMiracles.name: Bloody Icon
thebanMiracles.summary: Sacrifice Humanity so a holy icon weeps Vitae.
thebanMiracles.requirement: Detach from Humanity during a religious reverie
thebanMiracles.duration: Until the stored Vitae is consumed
thebanMiracles.effect: The statue produces Vitae equal to casting successes, which causes neither blood addiction nor Vinculum, then crumbles when emptied.

thebanMiracles.name: The Walls of Jericho
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless a horn to break barriers between the bearer and a named Kindred.
thebanMiracles.effect: Blowing the horn removes Structure from intervening barriers per success; living obstacles suffer bashing damage.

thebanMiracles.name: Aaron’s Rod
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless a rod that becomes a venomous serpent when cast down.
thebanMiracles.effect: The serpent obeys its wielder or instructions set during the blessing; its venom destroys Vitae or deals lethal damage with Toxicity equal to Blood Potency.

thebanMiracles.name: Blessing the Legion
thebanMiracles.summary: Store Vitae in blessed armor so a crusader can heal beyond normal per-turn limits.
