thebanMiracles.effect: The caster or wearer stores Vitae up to Theban Sorcery in the armor. While worn, it spends one stored Vitae per turn to heal without counting against the wearer's Vitae-per-turn limit; extra successes bless additional suits.

thebanMiracles.name: The Guiding Star
thebanMiracles.summary: Bless coins that guide bearers to a hidden refuge and blood bounty.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A star chart and gold coins
thebanMiracles.duration: One night per coin, extendable with Willpower
thebanMiracles.effect: A bearer follows the stars to a concealed Safe Place, Haven, and Feeding Ground equivalent to five dots, then forgets its location on leaving.

thebanMiracles.name: Miracle of the Dead Sun
thebanMiracles.summary: Destroy blessed jewelry and sacrifice Humanity to turn day into rainy night.
thebanMiracles.duration: Ten minutes per remaining Humanity dot
thebanMiracles.effect: The domain becomes a sunless storm in which vampires function as at night and may awaken normally.

thebanMiracles.name: Pledge to the Worthless One
thebanMiracles.summary: Swear to Belial for feeding power, frenzy's strength, and a demonic familiar.
thebanMiracles.effect: Choose a deadly sin: active sinners provide twice normal Vitae and innocents half; gain frenzy bonuses, lose Touchstone benefits, bear a mark, and receive a Retainer ••••• familiar with three Disciplines.

thebanMiracles.name: Great Prophecy
thebanMiracles.summary: Declare a group's fate within the next month and the means to escape it.
thebanMiracles.duration: One month or until fulfilled or averted
thebanMiracles.effect: A positive prophecy grants temporary Merits up to Theban Sorcery; a negative one can destroy Merits up to casting successes but cannot directly cause Final Death.

thebanMiracles.name: Apocalypse
thebanMiracles.summary: Reveal signs of supernatural beings' true nature across a wide area.
thebanMiracles.effect: Within a half-mile area per five successes beyond the first ten, supernatural natures become evident and Obfuscate or comparable illusions fail or Clash with the miracle.

thebanMiracles.name: The Judgment Fast
thebanMiracles.summary: Curse a domain so vampires cannot sustain Vitae above Humanity.
thebanMiracles.effect: Vitae above a vampire's Humanity can neither be stored nor used and is vomited out as worthless blood.

thebanMiracles.name: Curse of Isolation
thebanMiracles.summary: Sever a vampire from a present Touchstone and temporarily steal that bond.

thebanMiracles.name: Orison of Voices
thebanMiracles.summary: For three nights, hear speech anywhere that invokes your name.

thebanMiracles.name: Sins of the Ancestors
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A quantity of the victim's blood
thebanMiracles.summary: Ask simple questions about members of the victim's blood lineage.

thebanMiracles.name: Trials of Job
thebanMiracles.summary: Lay a sequence of escalating biblical trials upon the subject.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Spider's Hijra
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Weave a web of Vitae that penalizes others' Physical actions for a night.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Sayih's Khol
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Protect a subject from underwater conditions for a night.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Al-Ajsad
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Give undead life to a homunculus servant.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Ebony Horse
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Animate an object up to Size 7 as a flying vehicle for a night.

kimiyaFormulae.name: Curse of the Monkey Prince
kimiyaFormulae.summary: Curse a subject to transform painfully into an animal if they commit a declared transgression.

therionSacrileges.name: Demon's Tongue
therionSacrileges.summary: Gain 8-again to Subterfuge and contest supernatural truth powers for the night.

therionSacrileges.name: The Morning Star
therionSacrileges.summary: Add Therion to the Predatory Aura for the night and assume a dark angelic aspect.

therionSacrileges.name: Curse the Faithful
therionSacrileges.summary: Replace a mortal witness's Virtue with an additional compulsive Vice.

therionSacrileges.name: Avatar of Apollyon
therionSacrileges.summary: Become the bane of a chosen angelic or demonic quarry for up to a scene.

therionSacrileges.name: Profanity
therionSacrileges.summary: Sense and desecrate sacred places, weakening alien powers and strengthening Chorists.

therionSacrileges.name: Apotheosis
therionSacrileges.summary: Become a vampiric angel wielding the Influences and Numina of consumed divinities.

therionSacrileges.name: Nine Choirs Bend the Knee
therionSacrileges.summary: Force nearby angels and demons to Materialize and spend Willpower to disobey.

gildedInvocations.name: Crowdsourcing
gildedInvocations.summary: Turn nearby strangers into a temporary source of coordinated information and assistance.

gildedInvocations.name: Green Light
gildedInvocations.summary: Make urban routes and systems favor movement through the affected area.

gildedInvocations.name: Red Light
gildedInvocations.summary: Make urban routes and systems obstruct movement through the affected area.

gildedInvocations.name: Semiotics
gildedInvocations.summary: Rewrite the social meaning of signs and landmarks within the affected area.

gildedInvocations.name: Cordon
gildedInvocations.summary: Turn a boundary into an occult barrier that discourages or blocks passage.

gildedInvocations.name: Gerrymandering
gildedInvocations.summary: Redefine which places and people count as belonging to the Invocation's area.

gildedInvocations.name: Rezoning
gildedInvocations.summary: Change the supernatural character and permitted uses of an urban district.

gildedInvocations.name: Synopticon
gildedInvocations.summary: Use the city's systems and observers as a supernatural surveillance network.

gildedInvocations.name: Rapid Transit
gildedInvocations.summary: Create an impossibly efficient route between prepared points in the city.

gildedInvocations.name: Remise à neuf
gildedInvocations.summary: Renew a district according to the Architects' intended design.

detournements.name: Contagion Principle
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Beast's Hackles
detournements.summary: Implant a Vitae-soaked severed finger and track its bearer for a number of nights equal to Vitae spent.
detournements.procedure: Amputate a finger for one lethal damage, soak it in Vitae, and implant it in the subject.
detournements.outcome: Track with Wits + Empathy; a vampire subject resists with Stamina + Blood Potency.

detournements.name: Eye Behind Glass
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Twilight Projection
detournements.summary: Sacrifice an eye to a camera and perceive through its feed at the cost of impaired normal vision.
detournements.procedure: Gouge out an eye for one lethal damage and install it within a camera.
detournements.outcome: Access the feed remotely; while doing so, Perception and Defense suffer −3.

detournements.name: Face of New Flesh
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Lay Open the Mind
detournements.summary: Wear a mortal's surgically removed face as an undetectable identity and media focus.
detournements.procedure: Remove the vampire's face for one aggravated damage and replace it with the victim's.
detournements.outcome: The disguise defeats aura and medical scrutiny and interacts normally with Blush of Life.

detournements.name: Pleasure of Text
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Spirit's Touch
detournements.summary: Consume the contents of a written or recorded medium and retain them with perfect clarity.
detournements.procedure: Coat the medium and the vampire's tongue in Vitae, then ritually consume its information.
detournements.outcome: Gain Eidetic Memory for days equal to Vitae spent and erase the original medium.

detournements.name: Soul Transplant
detournements.prerequisites: Moulding Room Initiation •; optional Uncanny Perception
detournements.summary: Implant a ritually prepared worm beneath the sternum to displace the subject's soul and expose supernatural insight.
detournements.procedure: Insert the prepared parasite through the sternum for one lethal damage.
detournements.outcome: The subject becomes Soulless while the implant remains; the vampire gains the procedure's occult insight.

coils.name: Coil of the Ascendant
coils.summary: Transcends daysleep, fire, and sunlight through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Surmounting the Daysleep
levels.summary: Remain active by day more easily while Blush of Life is active.
levels.effect: While benefiting from Blush of Life, no roll is required to resist daysleep and remaining active by day does not inflict Lethargic.

ruleEffects.condition: Blush of Life active during daytime

levels.name: The Warm Face
levels.summary: Extend Blush of Life to a full day.
levels.effect: Blush of Life lasts 24 hours rather than one scene.

levels.name: Conquer the Red Fear
levels.summary: Fire and sunlight no longer provoke frenzy.
levels.effect: Exposure to fire or sunlight does not trigger frenzy, though damage still applies normally.

levels.name: Peace with the Flame
levels.summary: Downgrade fire damage while Blush of Life is active.
levels.effect: While Blush of Life is active, fire deals lethal rather than aggravated. Each Resilience dot can further downgrade one point of that fire damage from lethal to bashing.

ruleEffects.value: one lethal → bashing per Resilience dot

levels.name: Sun's Forgotten Kiss
levels.summary: Spend extra Vitae with Blush of Life to slow sunlight damage intervals.
levels.cost: Additional Vitae when activating Blush of Life
levels.effect: Each extra Vitae makes Blood Potency count one lower for sunlight damage interval only, minimum effective Blood Potency 1.

ruleEffects.value: 1 per extra Vitae spent with Blush of Life

coils.name: Coil of the Wyrm
coils.summary: Refines and directs the Beast through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Stir the Beast
levels.summary: Enter a voluntary frenzy with a declared objective.
levels.effect: Enter frenzy voluntarily and name a short goal. Escaping before the goal is met suffers a penalty; the frenzy ends when the goal is no longer pressing or possible.

levels.name: Beast's Hunger
levels.summary: Increase effective Blood Potency for senses and predatory aura while frenzying.
levels.effect: During any frenzy, add the current Coil of the Wyrm rating to Blood Potency for Kindred senses and predatory aura.

levels.name: Leash the Beast
levels.summary: Ride the Wave without Willpower and with a Coil bonus.
levels.effect: Riding the Wave no longer costs Willpower and gains the Coil of the Wyrm rating as bonus dice.

levels.name: Beast's Power
levels.summary: Surrender fully to frenzy for major physical bonuses.
levels.effect: When entering frenzy, the Dragon may forgo resistance until the Beast is sated; during that frenzy add Blood Potency to Defense, Health, and Speed.

levels.name: Eternal Frenzy
levels.summary: Remain frenzying despite lethal wounds that would normally force torpor.
levels.effect: While in frenzy, filling Health with lethal damage does not cause torpor. If frenzy ends while Health is still full of lethal, torpor begins immediately; frenzy may persist across scenes.

coils.name: Coil of the Voivode
coils.summary: Transforms Vitae addiction, blood sympathy, blood bonds, and the Embrace.

levels.name: Taste of Fealty
levels.summary: Make the Dragon's Vitae exceptionally addictive and uniquely satisfying.
levels.effect: Each point of the Dragon's Vitae counts as two for Vitae addiction; addicts can resolve blood-addiction Deprived only with Vitae from someone possessing this Coil.

levels.name: Into the Fold
levels.summary: Create blood sympathy with blood-bound subjects.
levels.effect: The Dragon and blood-bound subjects gain blood sympathy with closeness based on bond stage.

ruleEffects.value: stage 1 = four-times removed; stage 2 = three-times removed; stage 3 = twice removed

levels.name: Call to Serve
levels.summary: Accelerate a new blood bond with extra Vitae.
levels.effect: Three Vitae in one brief feeding can establish stage two; five Vitae can establish stage three. This expenditure ignores the normal Vitae-per-turn limit.

levels.name: Voivode Undisputed
levels.summary: Turn blood sympathy into resistance instead of vulnerability.
levels.effect: Blood sympathy gives no Discipline bonus against the Dragon; the Dragon adds her blood-sympathy bonus to resist blood bonds and contest predatory aura from those she has bound.

ruleEffects.value: blood-sympathy attack bonus removed against Dragon

levels.name: The Vast Dynasty
levels.summary: Replace automatic Humanity loss from Embrace with a lower breaking point.
levels.effect: Embracing no longer automatically costs Humanity. It becomes a Humanity 3 breaking point, with +1 die to avoid detachment.

ruleEffects.value: Humanity 3 breaking point; +1 die to detachment

coils.name: Coil of Zirnitra
coils.summary: Transforms mortal Supernatural Merits into controllable tools of the Dragon's perfected mind.

levels.name: Opening the Third Eye
levels.summary: Unlock mortal Supernatural Merits through the Coil.
levels.effect: Each Coil dot unlocks one mortal Supernatural Merit. Activation costs one additional Vitae and failed uses can become dramatic failures.

levels.name: Unleash the Mind
levels.summary: Use Supernatural Merits without normal Willpower timing restrictions.
levels.effect: Willpower spent on Supernatural Merits does not count against the per-turn Willpower limit; their printed drawbacks and dramatic failures remain.

levels.name: Embolden Potential
levels.summary: Enhance Supernatural Merits with Vitae and buy them more cheaply.
levels.effect: Physical Intensity can enhance physical expressions of Supernatural Merits; each dot costs one less Experience, minimum one, and no longer costs extra Vitae.

levels.name: The Dragon’s Breath
levels.summary: Spend Willpower for a Coil-sized bonus and avoid dramatic failures.
levels.effect: Willpower adds the Coil rating as bonus dice to a Supernatural Merit and failed uses no longer become dramatic failures.

levels.name: Ascendancy
levels.summary: Perfect Supernatural Merits beyond mortal limits.
levels.effect: Suffer one unavoidable aggravated damage to give a Supernatural Merit the rote quality; Coil dots no longer limit how many such Merits may be learned.

coils.name: Coil of Ziva
coils.summary: Transforms Humanity, detachment, banes, and the Beast's hold on the Dragon.

levels.name: Denying the Bane
levels.summary: Raise effective Humanity against most banes.
levels.effect: For banes other than fire and sunlight, add Coil dots to Humanity when determining their effects.

levels.name: Buttress the Soul
levels.summary: Spend Vitae to resist detachment.
levels.effect: Spend Vitae up to the per-turn limit and add one die per Vitae to a detachment roll.

levels.name: Enliven the Anima
levels.summary: Replace a detachment Condition with Raptured.
levels.effect: Spend Willpower after detachment to take the Raptured Condition instead of the Condition that would normally result.

levels.name: Embracing the Banes
levels.summary: Callous Humanity against many self-chosen banes.
levels.effect: Maintain a number of voluntarily adopted banes up to Willpower dots rather than the normal limit.

levels.name: Shedding the Beast’s Skin
levels.summary: Temporarily become a living mortal.
levels.effect: Spend three Willpower and five turns to shed vampiric traits for 11 − Blood Potency hours; returning takes 30 minutes and restores limited Vitae.

coils.name: Mystery of the Quintessence
coils.summary: Bind the Dragon to a centuries-old domain and become its dread avatar.

levels.name: Forever Mine
levels.summary: Claim a domain occupied for a century and sense forbidden Kindred predation within it.

levels.name: Home Turf
levels.summary: Residents must spend Willpower to resist your feeding.

levels.name: Smother
levels.summary: Suppress natural fire and contest supernatural flames in the domain.

levels.name: In the Motherland's Arms
levels.summary: Gain supernatural Safe Place and Haven protection while sleeping in the domain.

levels.name: Fingers on a Dead Pulse
levels.summary: Read residents' Vices and Conditions and receive domain-wide blood-sympathy visions.

scales.name: Day-Wake Conditioning
scales.summary: Reverse a vampire subject's sleep cycle while the conditioning is maintained.
scales.procedure: Force a vampire to resist daysleep until resistance falls to a chance die, then allow sleep only at dusk in a brightly lit chamber.
scales.outcome: The subject wakes at dawn and sleeps at night indefinitely while continuing to sleep in bright light each night; more than two consecutive nights without doing so ends the effect.

scales.name: Epidermal Shielding Bath
scales.summary: Temporarily improve a Kindred subject's effective Humanity against sunlight.
scales.procedure: Submerge a Kindred in an alchemical bath for one hour while Vitae is bled into the mixture.
scales.outcome: For 24 hours, each Vitae invested increases effective Humanity by one for sunlight damage only.

scales.name: Flesh Graft Treatment
scales.summary: Temporarily make grievous wounds easier to heal.
scales.procedure: Prepare mortal skin grafts in fresh human blood, bind them over damaged areas, and inject very fresh human blood.
scales.outcome: Kindred can heal aggravated damage with Vitae as though it were lethal. Mortals can heal lethal with Vitae supplied in the treatment; this may create a blood bond/ghoul.

scales.name: Augmented Vitae Draught
scales.summary: Bottle a Physical Intensity augmentation for a mortal.
scales.procedure: Use sterilized needles and tubing, then trigger Physical Intensity so the spent Vitae drains into a sealed vessel.
scales.outcome: The stored Vitae remains potent for Blood Potency hours. A mortal drinking it gains the physical augmentation for a scene, then takes bashing damage equal to twice the Vitae invested and develops blood addiction.

scales.name: Kindred Sense Endowment
scales.summary: Grant a mortal temporary vampire-like blood senses.
scales.procedure: Prepare and distill a blood-and-bone mixture, apply it to the subject's eyes and nose, and have the subject ingest the remainder.
scales.outcome: For about 24 hours the mortal senses blood as though Blood Potency 2 and develops a dangerous hunger for human blood.

scales.name: Surgical Heart Removal
scales.summary: Remove a Kindred subject's heart through a reversible but dangerous operation.
scales.procedure: Perform a six-hour surgery: extended Intelligence + Medicine, 10 successes, one-hour interval. Reversal uses the same roll.
scales.outcome: On success the subject cannot be staked and cannot gain Vitae from feeding, but can still spend stored Vitae or gain it from blood sorcery. Destroying the body eventually regenerates it from the heart; destroying the heart kills the subject.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The heart is destroyed; the subject frenzies and reaches Final Death at scene end.
rollResults.failure: The subject falls into torpor as if staked until the heart is restored.
rollResults.success: Heart removal succeeds with the listed consequences.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Normal extended-action exceptional-success benefit only.

scales.name: Blood Cleansing Ritual
scales.summary: Attempt to remove an existing blood bond.
scales.procedure: Prepare an animal-blood and viscera wash mixed with several Vitae and repeatedly force it through the restrained subject's nose and mouth.
scales.outcome: For each Vitae invested, roll Dragon Blood Potency minus the bond creator's Blood Potency; any success permanently removes the bond. The Dragon's Vitae in the wash does not create a new bond.

scales.name: Fealty's Reward
scales.summary: Create an unusually enduring ghoul from a stage-three bound mortal.
scales.procedure: Drain a stage-three blood-bound mortal to the last Health box, collect the Dragon's gained Vitae, have the subject drink it, then rest 48 hours.
scales.outcome: The subject becomes a ghoul for one year rather than one month, renewable only by the Dragon. If the state expires, the ghoul dies and later rises as a draugr.

scales.name: Mass Embrace
scales.summary: Embrace a prepared group through one collective procedure.
scales.procedure: Gather mortals in a basin-like space, bleed out the Dragon's Vitae, drain the subjects into the pool, drink from the pooled blood, and inject it into the corpses.
scales.outcome: Subjects rise at Blood Potency 1 with one Vitae. Each makes a chance die: success = control, failure = immediate frenzy, dramatic failure = draugr. The Dragon loses Humanity as with an ordinary Embrace.

scales.name: Sanguinary Invigoration
scales.summary: Prepare a living vessel so much higher-Blood-Potency vampires can feed from it.
scales.procedure: Mix one extracted Vitae with arcane ingredients and inject the fresh preparation into a living human or animal within ten minutes.
scales.outcome: For one week, the Dragon treats Blood Potency as four lower when checking whether she can feed from the subject and four higher for smelling the subject's blood. The subject is not blood-bound or addicted by the injection itself.

scales.name: Psychic Lobotomy
scales.summary: Surgically remove a subject's Supernatural Merits while hardening the damaged mind.
scales.procedure: Remove and preserve part of the subject's brain through ritual surgery.
scales.outcome: The subject loses a Mental or Social dot and all Supernatural Merits, but adds the Dragon's Zirnitra rating to resist mental probing or influence until the aggravated injury regenerates.

scales.name: Grafting Unholy Flesh
scales.summary: Graft a supernatural body part onto a vampire or ghoul to steal one power.
scales.procedure: On a Wyrm's Nest, remove the supernatural organ and graft it into a vampire or ghoul with one Vitae.
scales.outcome: The recipient can use the stolen power, paying one Vitae and one Willpower for each printed non-Vitae/Willpower cost; the donor loses the power while the graft survives.

scales.name: Bleed the Sin
scales.summary: Drain a subject so the next increase of Humanity or Integrity costs less.
scales.procedure: Keep the subject drained of blood for ten minutes while conducting the Scale.
scales.outcome: The subject receives a one-time Experience discount on the next dot of Humanity or another Integrity trait equal to the Dragon's Ziva rating.

scales.name: Siphon the Soul
scales.summary: Nearly diablerize a vampire to steal one dot of Humanity.
scales.procedure: Drain the restrained vampire in a controlled imitation of diablerie and complete the prescribed contest.
scales.outcome: Success steals one Humanity dot from that subject once, leaves the victim in torpor, and forces the Dragon to face a Humanity 1 breaking point and spiritual taint.

scales.name: Cold of the Grave
scales.summary: Share Smother with every vampire who calls the domain home.

scales.name: Spirit Tether
scales.summary: Gain astral projection through a regimen of Vitae, hallucinogens, and near-torpor.

scales.name: Psychic Leech
scales.summary: Drain Vitae from attuned people and places while astrally projected.

scales.name: Beseech the Sleeping
scales.summary: Learn recent memories from sleeping mortals during Spirit Tether.

scales.name: Command the Mind
scales.summary: Spend a permanent Willpower dot to drain Willpower through Vitae.
